_comment: One entry per book of the Bible, Genesis → Revelation, for the Holy Bible screen. 'verse' is the book's key verse, shown on its card in the reader's language (pulled from the full Bible built by tool/build_bible.dart, so it is always the translation's own words). 'scene' describes the book's picture: the original goes in art/books/<code>.png or .jpg and is built into assets/books/ by tool/build_story_images.py. Until a book has its own picture it shows the picture of 'story' (a Bible Story id), or else a painting of Jesus.

books.scene: Light bursting into the dark at creation: galaxies, a new earth, a garden waking in golden dawn
Moses raising his staff as the Red Sea parts into towering walls of water, a people walking through
The tabernacle in the desert at dusk, smoke rising from the altar, the glory cloud glowing above
Israel's camp spread across the wilderness under a pillar of fire at night, tents in their tribes
Aged Moses on Mount Nebo gazing over the green Promised Land at sunrise
Priests carrying the ark across the Jordan as the river stands still, Jericho's walls in the distance
Gideon's three hundred men raising torches and trumpets over the valley at night
Ruth gleaning golden barley at harvest in Bethlehem's fields, Naomi watching kindly
Young shepherd David anointed by Samuel, oil glowing on his head, sheep on the hills behind
King David dancing with joy before the ark as it enters Jerusalem, crowds and music
Fire falling from heaven on Elijah's altar on Mount Carmel before a stunned crowd
Elisha's servant seeing the hills full of horses and chariots of fire around the city
Levite singers and musicians with harps and cymbals praising God before the ark
Fire and glory filling Solomon's golden temple as the people bow at its dedication
Returned exiles laying the temple's foundation in Jerusalem, some shouting for joy, some weeping
Nehemiah and the people rebuilding Jerusalem's walls, tools in one hand, the city rising
Queen Esther in royal robes stepping bravely into the Persian king's throne room
Job looking up from the ashes as God speaks out of a mighty whirlwind under the stars
A shepherd leading his sheep beside still waters through green pastures in soft morning light
A father teaching his son on a hillside at sunset, an open scroll of wisdom between them
One great tree passing through spring, summer, autumn and winter under a turning sky
Vineyards and blossoming gardens in spring, a lily among thorns, doves in the morning light
An eagle soaring high on the wind over mountains bathed in rising sunlight
A potter shaping clay on his wheel, the prophet Jeremiah watching in the workshop's glow
Morning sunrise breaking over the ruins of Jerusalem, new light on old stones
The valley of dry bones coming to life as breath sweeps over them in a radiant wind
Daniel calm in the lions' den, an angel's light shining, the lions lying down at peace
A father tenderly lifting a small child to his cheek, cords of kindness and love
Rain falling on parched fields as they turn green, young and old looking up to heaven
A mighty river of clear water rolling through a dry land, justice flowing like a stream
The rock city of Edom high in red cliffs, and Mount Zion shining in the distance
Jonah swallowed by a great fish beneath a stormy sea, a ship tossing above
Little Bethlehem on its hills at night under a bright star, shepherds' fires glowing
A strong stone fortress on a hill sheltering people from a storm sweeping the plain
A deer leaping surefooted across high mountain rocks at dawn
God's people gathered in Jerusalem rejoicing with song, light pouring down over them
Builders raising the second temple's pillars in Jerusalem, glory shining through the scaffolding
A golden lampstand burning brightly between two olive trees in a night vision
The sun of righteousness rising with healing in its wings over fields, calves leaping for joy
Jesus teaching the Sermon on the Mount to a great crowd on a sunlit hillside by the lake
Jesus standing in a boat calming a raging storm on the Sea of Galilee, disciples in awe
The father running to embrace his returning prodigal son on the road home at sunset
Jesus, the light of the world, holding a lamp in the darkness, His face full of love
Tongues of fire resting on the disciples at Pentecost in Jerusalem, a mighty wind
Paul writing a letter by lamplight, a scroll before him, the city of Rome beyond the window
Hands of many people of every age joined together around a glowing light of love
A butterfly emerging from its cocoon in morning light, a new creation
A tree heavy with nine kinds of glowing fruit in a sunlit garden
A believer clothed in the shining armour of God: belt, breastplate, shield and sword of the Spirit
Paul singing in a prison cell at midnight, chains on his wrists, light streaming through the bars
Workers of many trades — carpenter, farmer, mother, writer — working gladly in warm light
Believers in Thessalonica looking up at dawn as clouds part and light breaks through
A lighthouse standing firm against a storm at sea, its beam guiding the way
Paul with his hand on young Timothy's shoulder, encouraging him before a gathered church
A runner finishing a race with arms raised, a crown of victory waiting at the line
Titus on the island of Crete teaching a house church by the sea at sunset
A master embracing his runaway servant Onesimus as a brother, a letter in hand
Abraham under a sky full of stars, counting them in faith beside his tent
A small rudder steering a great ship through the waves, and a spark lighting a forest
A pair of hands releasing a heavy bundle of worries into the light above
The morning star rising over a dark mountain, the first light of a new day
A family of every generation embracing in warm golden light — God is love
An elder's letter sealed with love being delivered to a woman and her children
Gaius welcoming travelling teachers into his home with food and lamplight
A hand catching a stumbling traveller on a rocky mountain path above the clouds
The new Jerusalem descending from heaven, shining like jasper, a river of life flowing from the throne
